tex_content.source:
\label{hanlin:maxprin-section-2-4}

Consider
\[
a_{ij}(x)D_{ij}u+b_i(x)D_iu=f(x,u)
\quad\text{in }\Omega,
\]
where $\Omega\subset\mathbb R^n$ is bounded and connected, the coefficients are
bounded and continuous, and
\[
a_{ij}(x)\xi_i\xi_j\ge\lambda|\xi|^2.
\]
